title: cirsium × tataricum
intro: Cirsium × tataricum, commonly known as Tatar milk thistle, is a hybrid plant species within the sunflower family, derived from the cross between Cirsium vulgare and Cirsium heterophyllum. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help in reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium × tataricum include its ability to modulate the immune system, inhibit the growth of pathogens, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
